definition: Showing disrespect towards God or other things regarded as sacred.
author: Henry James
quote: Well, my eyes were sealed, it appeared, at present—a consummation for which it seemed blasphemous not to thank God.
example_sentence: To my grandad, putting milk in first is blasphemous.
